events.title: The next region is here!
events.summary: Hi Terraformers,I'm pumped to announce that a new region, Tidehaven, is here!Tidehaven is a barren volcanic wasteland and it's up to you to transform it back into the tropical oasis it once was.This region introduces some new mechanics and I'd love to hear what you think of them.First up is automation. events.title: Getting Out of the Player’s Way
events.summary: "Busy Trash"It’s not the feedback I wanted to hear, but it was feedback I needed to hear.Players were spending too much time managing inventory and navigating menus — and not enough time actually playing the game.So the latest update takes a big swing at fixing that.Your backpack now has 50% more storage at every upgrade level, and I’ve moved a feature I was originally saving for Region 2 into the first region. events.title: Fixing what was broken
events.summary: “It’s boring.”That’s the constructive criticism I heard most after the demo launched on Monday.And you know what? You were right.Every action you took brought the next enemy wave close but terraforming increased every second. events.summary: I’ve been working on this game whenever I can for over a year, and today is a pretty big milestone for me: you can finally play it.The demo takes you through the first region of the game and introduces the core systems: building, terraforming, exploration, and combat.
